hook.name: AgroLastro PoolAGL
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for AgroLastro's AGL token that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the hook itself, permanently locking the full token supply in a single-sided price-ladder arrangement. afterSwap tracks net AGL flow via transient storage (EIP-1153) to maintain a transfer quota that the AGL token uses to gate physical transfers through the official pool.
